facts.text: I am looking for advice on how to improve my product displays at events.
Last week I had a great time at a craft fair at the local community center.
At the craft fair at the local community center, I sold handmade candles.
At the craft fair at the local community center, I sold knitted scarves.
I am struggling with creating a visually appealing layout for my product displays.
I have had some success with my candle-making skills.
I am thinking of expanding my product line to include different scents and colors.
I like the idea of creating a "New Arrivals" section.
I want to highlight my new scents and colors in a "New Arrivals" section.
I want advice on how to effectively price my new products.
I want my pricing to be competitive with other vendors at the holiday market.
I plan to research my competition and calculate my costs to determine a base price for each product.
I plan to tier my pricing to offer different options for customers.
I like the idea of offering bundles or promotions to incentivize customers to buy more.
For my new scents and colors, I might offer a "Limited Edition" bundle that includes a few of the new products at a discounted price.
I want the "Limited Edition" bundle to create a sense of urgency so customers buy sooner.
I think a loyalty program or rewards scheme can help encourage repeat customers and build a loyal following.
I have had some success with repeat customers at the craft fair and artisan market.
I think a loyalty program could help take that success to the next level.
I think a referral program is a fantastic idea.
I want to incentivize customers to refer their friends and family to attract new customers.
I want a referral program to create a viral effect that drives sales and grows my customer base.
I am considering a referral program that offers discounts for both referrers and referees.
In the referral program idea, the referrer would get 10% off their next purchase.
In the referral program idea, the new customer would get 15% off their first purchase.
I am considering a referral program that offers a free product to customers who refer a certain number of friends or family members.
In the referral program idea, if a customer refers 5 friends, they could get a free candle or scarf.
I am considering a referral program that gives referrers exclusive access to new products, limited editions, or special.
